flavours.name: Buenissimo
flavours.note: Milk-chocolate hazelnut gelato piled with cone crunch, hazelnut fudge and roasted hazelnut.

pairs.why: Bitter citrus gives the dense chocolate-hazelnut stack a clean reset.
Espresso bitterness extends the roast while checking the fudge sweetness.
Fresh berry gives praline-like chocolate and hazelnut a brighter edge.
High-acid tropical fruit is the strongest contrast to this very rich scoop.

flavours.name: Daddy Chill
flavours.note: Rum-and-raisin custard-tart gelato with buttery shortcrust.

pairs.why: Espresso bitterness counters dried-fruit sweetness and suits the custard.
Bitter citrus freshens rum, raisin and pastry.
A calm dairy bridge lets the rum-and-raisin tart stay central.
Dark cocoa deepens the warm rum and pastry notes.

flavours.name: Drop It Like White Choc
flavours.note: Salted caramelised white chocolate with extra caramelised white-chocolate chip.

pairs.why: High acidity cuts caramelised white chocolate most decisively.
Espresso gives a drier, roasted counterweight to the sweetness.
Tangy berry yoghurt supplies both fruit and dairy contrast.
Bitter citrus resets the long caramelised-white-chocolate finish.

flavours.name: Dulce de Coco
flavours.note: Coconut dulce de leche with desiccated coconut and dark-chocolate chips.

pairs.why: Sharp tropical acidity cuts coconut caramel while staying in the same broad flavour world.
Espresso bitterness checks dulce sweetness and darkens the chocolate.
Clean mango gives the coconut side a bright tropical echo.
Bitter citrus is the hardest reset for the dulce and chocolate.

flavours.name: Fior di Fragola
flavours.note: Fior di latte with Marsala and strawberry puree - creamy berry with a light wine note.

pairs.why: Strawberry and pistachio form a natural fruit-nut bridge.
Creamy strawberry softens dark cocoa while Marsala adds depth.
Lemon pulls the strawberry toward a fresher, brighter register.
A simple milk-and-vanilla bridge keeps the strawberry legible.

flavours.name: Just Like a Milkshake
flavours.note: Coco Pops milk gelato with crunchy Coco Pop clusters.

pairs.why: Fresh berry turns chocolate cereal milk into a lighter sundae-like pairing.
Espresso adds roast and keeps sweet cereal milk from flattening out.
Bitter citrus gives cocoa cereal an adult, cleaner finish.
Roasted hazelnut makes the cocoa-cereal profile feel deliberate rather than merely sweet.

flavours.name: Mitchos Milo Tart
flavours.note: Milo custard gelato with shortcrust - malty chocolate custard in tart form.

pairs.why: Espresso extends the malt and cocoa while drying the finish.
Citrus cuts dense custard, malt and pastry.
Tangy berry yoghurt is a softer lift for the tart richness.
Lean dark cocoa deepens Milo without adding more dairy weight.

flavours.name: Mr. Potato Head
flavours.note: Peanut-butter gelato with white-chocolate-covered potato chips - salty, nutty and crunchy.

pairs.why: Fresh strawberry gives peanut butter a PB-and-jam style contrast.
High acid cuts both peanut fat and white-chocolate sweetness.
Roast suits peanut while bitterness keeps the sweet-salty stack controlled.
Bitter citrus is a decisive reset after salty peanut and white chocolate.

flavours.name: Robert Brownie Jnr
flavours.note: Milk-chocolate gelato loaded with chocolate brownie and chocolate fudge.

pairs.why: Bitter citrus cuts the brownie-fudge density cleanly.
High-acid tropical fruit gives maximum contrast to the chocolate stack.
Espresso sharpens cocoa and reins in the fudge.
Fresh berry gives rich milk chocolate a lighter dessert contrast.

flavours.name: Spill the Tea
flavours.note: Hong Kong milk-tea gelato with brown-sugar caramel and baked cheesecake.

pairs.why: Sharp citrus lifts tannic tea, caramel and cheesecake without adding more weight.
Bitter orange echoes tea tannin and resets the brown-sugar finish.
Roasted pistachio gives milk tea a savoury-nut bridge.
A quiet dairy partner lets the tea remain the dominant aroma.

flavours.name: The Don
flavours.note: Salted-caramel gelato with whipped cream, chocolate chips and pretzel crunch.

pairs.why: Espresso is the cleanest bitter counterweight to caramel, cream and pretzel.
Bitter citrus resets the sweet-salty caramel stack.
Tangy berry yoghurt provides a softer fruit-and-acid lift.
Lean dark cocoa deepens the chocolate and pretzel without adding more cream.
